DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この部品の目視確認は、どこまで進みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: How far have you got with the visual inspection of these parts?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二枚見ましたが、記録の表と裏を逆に書いた可能性があります。傷の有無を確定する前に、面の呼び方を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二部品の表裏記録が逆かもしれず確定前に面の呼称を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've checked two, but I may have recorded their front and back the wrong way round. Before confirming whether there are scratches, I'd like to check what each face is called.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the front and back records for two parts may be reversed and ask about face names before confirming them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図面では丸穴が右に来る向きを表としています。現物を削ったり磨いたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: On the drawing, the front is the orientation with the round hole on the right. Have you filed or polished the actual parts?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、状態を見るだけで、表面には手を加えていません。丸穴を左に置いて見ていたので、記録が逆かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 加工せず丸穴を左にして観察したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I've only looked at their condition and haven't altered the surfaces. I was looking with the round hole on the left, so my records may be reversed.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you observed them with the round hole on the left and did no processing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二枚の記録に未確認と書き、ほかの確認済みの物と分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Mark the records for those two as unverified and separate them from the other, inspected parts.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この二枚だけ未確認にします。確認済みの箱へ入れていたわけではなく、今も検査台にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二枚だけ未確認にし確認済み箱へは入れていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll mark just these two as unverified. I hadn't put them in the inspected box; they're still on the inspection bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll mark only those two unverified and haven't put them in the inspected box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図面の向きに合わせ、確認担当と一緒に見直しましょう。最初に見た位置は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's align them with the drawing and review them with the inspector. Do you remember the first spot you examined?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 丸穴の近くの線を見ていました。表の不具合と書く前に、その線がどちらの面にあるかを示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 丸穴近くの線の所在を面名で断定前に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was looking at the line near the round hole. Before recording it as a front-face defect, I'll show which face that line is actually on.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show where the line by the round hole is before definitively naming the face. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見直して面の呼び方が一致してから、記録を修正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll correct the records after reviewing them and agreeing on the face names.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の記録を消して分からなくせず、見直した結果として修正します。次の部品も図面の向きから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原記録を隠さず見直し結果として修正し次品も図面方向を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't erase the original records so they become untraceable; I'll correct them as the result of the review. For the next part, I'll start by checking its orientation against the drawing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct the records as a review result without concealing the originals, and check the drawing orientation for the next part. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認担当へこの内容を引き継ぎます。検査台でお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass this on to the inspector. Please wait at the inspection bench. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 水道の使用開始の申込書をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll take your application to start water service.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 渡す前に気づきました。部屋番号に前の住まいの二〇一を書いてしまいました。新しい部屋は四〇二です。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申込提出前に旧部屋二〇一記入を発見し新部屋四〇二と訂正を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I noticed something before handing it in. I wrote 201, my old apartment number. The new apartment is 402.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report before submitting that you wrote the old apartment number, 201, and the new one is 402. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい建物の名前と住所は、正しく書けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you entered the new building name and address correctly?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 建物名と番地は新しい契約書に合わせています。違うのは部屋番号だけです。契約書の該当欄もお見せできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 建物と番地は新契約通りで誤りは部屋番号のみと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The building name and street number match the new contract. Only the apartment number is wrong. I can show you that section of the contract too.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that the building and street number match the new contract and only the apartment number is wrong. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書き直すための用紙をお渡しします。使用開始希望日も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll give you a fresh form. Please check your requested service start date as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい用紙に四〇二と書きます。希望日は引越し荷物が届く土曜日で、今日ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新用紙へ四〇二を書き希望開始は荷物到着の土曜と指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write 402 on the new form. My requested date is Saturday, when my moving boxes arrive, not today.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write 402 on the new form and specify Saturday, when your belongings arrive, as the requested start date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでは受付内容を確認し、対応可能な日程をご案内します。土曜日の開始を今確約することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check your application and explain the available dates. We can't promise a Saturday start right now.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 希望日を書けば確定すると思わず、受付後の案内を待ちます。連絡先は携帯の番号を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望日の受付は確約ではなく案内を待ち携帯番号を記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume writing a requested date makes it confirmed; I'll wait for the guidance after my application is received. I'll give my mobile number as the contact number.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that requesting a date isn't a guarantee, wait for guidance, and enter your mobile number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書き直した用紙をご提出ください。前の用紙は混同しないよう、受付で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please submit the rewritten form. We'll check the earlier form at reception to avoid confusion.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい用紙をこちらに出します。前の二〇一の用紙も一緒に渡し、どちらが訂正後か指して説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新旧用紙を渡し訂正後の用紙を明確に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here's the new form. I'll hand over the old form with 201 as well and point out clearly which one is the corrected version.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over both forms and clearly identify the corrected one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容を確認します。それでは、お手続きいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check the details. Thank you for completing the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: モーニングのホットコーヒーをお作りしてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I prepare the hot coffee for your breakfast set?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 注文を変えたいです。今日は手首が動かしにくく、持ち手を持つのがつらいので、背の低いグラスの飲み物があれば選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手首の動かしにくさから低いグラスの飲み物へ変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to change my order. My wrist is hard to move today, and holding a handle hurts, so if there's a drink served in a short glass, I'd like to choose that.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about changing to a drink in a short glass because your wrist is difficult to move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ作っていません。冷たい麦茶は低いグラスでお出しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I haven't made it yet. We can serve cold barley tea in a short glass.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら麦茶にします。冷たいコーヒーを希望したということではなく、グラスの持ちやすさで選びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冷たいコーヒー希望ではなく持ちやすさで麦茶を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll have barley tea. I wasn't asking for cold coffee; I chose it because the glass is easier to hold.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose barley tea for its easier-to-hold glass, rather than requesting cold coffee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 麦茶への変更で、パンのセットはそのままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Shall we change the drink to barley tea and leave the bread set as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パンはそのままお願いします。トーストの皿を自分で切り分けるとき動かしにくいので、店で半分に切れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: パンセットを維持してトーストの二分割を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please keep the bread. It would be awkward for me to move the toast plate while cutting it myself, so could you cut the toast in half here?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the bread set and ask for the toast to be cut in half. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 半分に切ってご用意します。席までこちらでお運びします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll prepare it cut in half and bring it to your seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 助かります。盆を片手で持って歩かず、席で待ちます。入口に近い席へ座ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 盆を片手運搬せず席で待ち入口近くの席の利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: That helps. I'll wait at my seat instead of walking with the tray in one hand. May I sit near the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you won't carry the tray one-handed, will wait seated, and ask to use a seat near the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その席は空いています。麦茶と半分に切ったトーストをお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: That seat is free. We'll bring barley tea and toast cut in half.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口近くへ行きます。元のホットコーヒーは取り消しで、麦茶一杯になったことを確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ホットコーヒー取消し麦茶一杯へ変更済みと確認して席へ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go near the entrance. I've confirmed that the original hot coffee is canceled and replaced with one glass of barley tea.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm hot coffee has been canceled and replaced by one barley tea, then go to your seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その内容です。それでは、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, that's correct. Please make yourself comfortable.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付はこちらです。チケットを拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Reception is here. May I see your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中から演奏が聞こえます。開演時刻より早く来ましたが、もう本番が始まったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 開演前の演奏音を聞き本番が始まったのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can hear music inside. I arrived before the advertised start time, but has the actual performance already begun?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the performance has begun after hearing music before the scheduled start. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は出演者が音を確認しています。本番はまだです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The performers are checking the sound now. The actual performance hasn't started.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 遅刻して曲を聞き逃したと思っていました。今の演奏は試奏で、客向けの一曲目ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 試奏で遅刻して一曲目を逃したわけではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I was late and had missed a piece. So what I'm hearing is a sound check, not the first piece for the audience.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm it's a trial performance and you haven't arrived late and missed the first piece. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。客席への案内は、この後に始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. We'll start showing people to their seats afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。扉から勝手に入らず、受付を済ませて案内を待ちます。今、チケットをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 扉へ勝手に入らず券受付を済ませ入場案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't go through the door on my own; I'll check in and wait for instructions. Here's my ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check in with your ticket and wait for admission guidance without entering through the door on your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認しました。会場に入る前に、お手洗いを使われますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've checked it. Would you like to use the restroom before entering the hall?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使いたいです。出入口の扉を開けず、廊下の奥へ行けばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会場扉を開けず廊下奥のお手洗いへ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. Can I just go to the end of the corridor without opening the hall's entrance door?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can reach the restroom down the corridor without opening the hall door. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、奥の表示の場所です。戻ったらこの待機場所へお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, it's where the sign is at the end. Come back to this waiting area afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お手洗いから戻ったら、待機場所に戻ります。演奏音が聞こえても、入場の合図とは受け取りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 戻ったら待機場所へ戻り音を入場合図と解釈しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll return to the waiting area after the restroom. Even if I hear music, I won't take that as a signal to enter.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll return to the waiting area and won't interpret music as an admission signal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内の声をお待ちください。それでは、公演をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait for the spoken announcement. Enjoy the performance.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申告の準備で、確認したい書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any documents you want to check while preparing your tax return?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ会社から源泉徴収票が二枚届きました。給与を二か所から受け取ったわけではないのに、二枚とも使うのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一社同年の源泉徴収票二枚を二社給与ではないと説明し扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received two withholding tax certificates from the same company. I haven't received wages from two employers, so I'm unsure whether I should use both.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you received two same-year withholding certificates from one company, not wages from two employers, and ask how to handle them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二枚は同じ年分で、一枚に訂正の表示がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are both for the same year, and does one say it's corrected?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらも同じ年分で、後から届いた封筒には訂正版と書かれています。書類自体のどの数字が変わったか、まだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後便封筒の訂正版表示と数字の違いは未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: They're both for the same year, and the envelope that arrived later says corrected version. I haven't yet figured out which figures on the document changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention the corrected-version label on the later envelope and that you haven't checked the numerical differences yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 両方を並べて、勤務先の説明も確認しましょう。二枚分を足して記入する前に整理する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's put them side by side and check the employer's explanation as well. We need to sort this out before entering the sum of both documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 足し算して書くのは待ちます。後の封筒に入っていた説明文も持ってきたので、一緒に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二枚を合算せず後便の説明文も提示を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll hold off adding the figures together. I brought the explanatory note from the later envelope too; could you look at it with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Don't add the two certificates together, and ask to show the explanation from the later delivery too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。前の書類を破棄したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. Have you discarded the earlier document?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ捨てていません。どちらが元の書類か分かるよう、最初の封筒と後の封筒に分けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧書類を捨てず元と後便の封筒で区別していると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I haven't thrown it away. I keep them in the first and later envelopes separately so I can tell which is the original.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you kept the old document and distinguish them using their original and later envelopes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明だけで分からない点は、勤務先に訂正内容を問い合わせることになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: For anything the explanation doesn't clarify, you'll need to ask your employer about the correction.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 勤務先には、同一年分の二枚のうち申告に用いる数字を確かめたいと聞きます。別会社分として扱わず、回答を控えて相談を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務先へ使用数字を問い合わせ別会社扱いせず回答を控えて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask my employer which figures from the two same-year certificates I should use for my return. I won't treat them as documents from different companies; I'll note the answer and continue the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask your employer which figures to use, avoid treating them as separate employers, and note the answer for the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 次の担当と確認を続けていただきますので、説明文をそろえてこちらでお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The next adviser will continue checking with you, so please gather the explanation and wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の記録が途中までですが、何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your inspection record stops partway through. Has something happened?

DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ部品を測り直すたびに数値が変わります。部品を判定する前に、この測定器を確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同一部品の測定値変動を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-02.translation: The reading changes every time I measure the same part again. Before judging the part, I'd like you to check this measuring instrument.
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report fluctuating measurements for the same part. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 測定のたびに置き方を変えましたか。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you change how you positioned it for each measurement?

DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 置き方は変えていません。二回目から数字が揺れたので、その後の検査は止めました。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 置き方不変と検査停止の経過を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I didn't change its position. The numbers started fluctuating on the second measurement, so I stopped further inspections.
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that positioning was unchanged and how you stopped inspection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま保留にしましょう。測定器を拭いたり調整したりする前の状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's leave it on hold. We'll check the instrument in its current state, before it's wiped or adjusted.

DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ触っていません。最初の値で良品にしてしまった三個も、確定から外してよいですか。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未調整状態と判定済三個の見直しを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't touched it yet. May we also remove from confirmed status the three parts I already marked good using the first reading?
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the instrument is unadjusted and ask to review the three parts already judged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 責任者に判定の扱いを確認します。三個は出荷側へ流さず、対象が分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the supervisor how to handle those judgments. Don't send the three parts toward shipping; make sure they can be identified.

DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三個を番号付きの保留トレーへ移し、記録には再確認待ちと書きます。器具の異常とはまだ断定しません。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象品保留と原因未断定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll move them to a numbered hold tray and write awaiting recheck in the record. I won't conclude yet that the instrument is faulty.
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the parts will be on hold and you haven't determined the cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の器具での再測定も、責任者が方法を指示してから行いましょう。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's also wait for the supervisor's instructions on the method before remeasuring with a different instrument.

DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分で器具を交換して記録を上書きせず、今の数値と止めた時刻を残して指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数値を上書きせず指示を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't swap instruments and overwrite the records myself. I'll keep the current readings and the time I stopped, and wait for instructions.
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait for instructions without overwriting the readings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を一緒に確認します。先に責任者へ連絡しますので、失礼します。
DLG-SC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check the situation together. I'll contact the supervisor first, so excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 時刻表の前でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Do you need help with the timetable?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 先発の欄にある列車へ乗りたいのですが、次発の時刻を自分のメモに書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 先発次発の時刻を取り違えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I want to board the train in the first-departure column, but I accidentally wrote the second train's time in my notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you mixed up the first and second departure times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 目的地と、メモした時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please tell me your destination and the time you noted.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 目的地はこの駅で、メモは十時十八分です。上の欄には十時十二分と出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 目的地と二つの表示時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: This station is my destination, and I wrote 10:18. The row above shows 10:12.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Give your destination and the two displayed times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの表示では、先発が十二分、次発が十八分です。先発は目的地を通過します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: On this display, the first train departs at twelve past and the second at eighteen past. The first passes your destination without stopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 早く来るほうなら何でもよいと思っていました。目的地に停まるのは十八分の列車ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 先発の通過を理解して次発の停車を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I thought any train that came sooner would do. Is it the 10:18 train that stops at my destination?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the first train passes your destination and ask whether the next stops there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そうです。次発の停車駅一覧に、目的地があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Your destination is on the next train's list of stops.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 十八分の列車を待ちます。先発が入ってきた時には、乗らずに表示をもう一度見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 先発に乗らず次発を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll wait for the 10:18 train. When the first train comes in, I won't board it; I'll check the display again.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Decide to wait for the second train without boarding the first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ホーム番号もメモへ加えておきませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Why not add the platform number to your notes too?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 時刻だけでなく、次発とホーム番号も書きます。教えてもらった列車の停車駅も確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: ホーム番号と停車駅もメモへ加える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll write not just the time, but also that it's the next train and the platform number. I've checked that train's stops too.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Add the platform number and stopping-station information to your notes too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お時間まで安全な位置でお待ちください。それでは、お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please wait in a safe place until it's time. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その野菜は量り売りです。計量のお手伝いをしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Those vegetables are sold by weight. Would you like help weighing them?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。袋に三本入れましたが、一本の値段か百グラムの値段か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 量り売りの価格単位を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, please. I put three in a bag, but I don't know if the price is per vegetable or per hundred grams.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask what unit the price for the weighed vegetables uses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 札の「百グラム当たり」が価格の単位です。袋ごとこちらの秤に載せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The sign says per hundred grams. Please place the bag on this scale.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二百グラム程度ほしいです。三本では多ければ、一本戻してよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 希望量と本数調整の可否を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like about two hundred grams. If three are too much, may I put one back?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State your desired weight and ask whether you can adjust the number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 量を見てから選びましょう。今は三百十グラムあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's decide after checking the weight. It's currently three hundred and ten grams.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 思ったより重いですね。一番大きい一本を外して、もう一度量っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 大きい一本を除いて再計量を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: That's heavier than I expected. Could you remove the largest one and weigh it again?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to remove the largest one and reweigh the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今度は二百五グラムです。この量でよろしければ計量ラベルを付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Now it's two hundred and five grams. If this amount is all right, I'll attach a weighing label.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この量にします。ラベルを貼ったあとで野菜を足すと、表示の重さと違ってしまいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 計量後の追加と重量表示の関係を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll take this amount. If I add more vegetables after the label goes on, the contents won't match the displayed weight, will they?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm how adding vegetables after weighing affects the weight label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その場合は再計量が必要です。この袋はもう一方の秤に載せる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then it would need reweighing. You don't need to put this bag on the other scale.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 二百五グラムの袋をそのまま持っていきます。残りの野菜は売場へ戻す位置を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 確定重量を保ち余りの返却先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll take the 205-gram bag as it is. Please tell me where to put the remaining vegetable back.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Keep the confirmed weight and ask where to return the extra vegetable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: こちらのかごで受け取ります。それでは、お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: We'll take it in this basket. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 先ほどご注文いただいた料理を準備しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: We're preparing the food you ordered earlier.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: すみません。急に職場から呼ばれ、あと五分で出なければなりません。まだなら注文を取り消したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 急用と退店期限を伝え調理前なら取消しを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Excuse me. Work has called me in unexpectedly, and I have to leave in five minutes. If it isn't started yet, I'd like to cancel my order.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain the urgent business and departure deadline, and request cancellation if cooking hasn't begun. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ラーメンはもう麺をゆでています。餃子はまだ焼き始めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The ramen noodles are already boiling. We haven't started cooking the dumplings yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ラーメンだけは調理中なのですね。全部まだだと思っていました。餃子の取消しから相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 調理中と未調理を分け餃子の取消しを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: So only the ramen is already being cooked. I thought nothing had started. Could we discuss canceling the dumplings first?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Distinguish food being cooked from food not yet started and ask about canceling the dumplings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらでは餃子は取り消せます。ラーメンについては、調理済みの分をどう扱うか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: We can cancel the dumplings. I'll check how we handle the ramen that's already being prepared.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 五分で食べ切ろうとして急ぐのはやめます。持ち帰れると思って箱を用意してもらうのも、確認前には頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 無理な早食いも未確認の持帰り依頼も避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I won't try to rush through it in five minutes. I also won't assume I can take it away and ask for a box before that's been checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Avoid rushing to eat and asking for an unconfirmed takeaway option. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 当店ではラーメンの持ち帰りは受けていません。お会計と取消しの確認だけ先にしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: We don't offer ramen to take away. Let's confirm the cancellation and bill first.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。餃子は取消し、調理中のラーメンの扱いは店の説明を聞いてから会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 取消し対象と調理中料理の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. I'll cancel the dumplings and listen to the restaurant's explanation about the ramen being cooked before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm what is canceled and how the food already being cooked will be handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ラーメン代はこちらではお支払いをお願いしています。餃子はお会計から外しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: We ask you to pay for the ramen. We've removed the dumplings from the bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 明細を見ました。餃子が外れていてラーメンだけですね。支払って、料理ができるのを待たずに職場へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 明細を照合し支払い後に待たず退店すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've checked the itemized bill. The dumplings are removed, and only the ramen remains. I'll pay and head to work without waiting for the food to be ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Check the itemized bill and say you'll pay and leave without waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 確認できました。お急ぎでも足元にお気をつけください。またのお越しをお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: That's confirmed. Please watch your step even though you're in a hurry. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日の診察では、ご一緒の方が通訳をなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Will the person accompanying you interpret for today's consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。ただ、友人は十一時に仕事へ戻るので、途中から電話の通訳者へ替わる予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 友人通訳が途中退席し電話通訳へ替わると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. But my friend has to return to work at eleven, so we plan to switch to a telephone interpreter partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend will leave partway through interpreting and you'll switch to a telephone interpreter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 切替えの予定を担当へ伝えます。電話の通訳者には連絡が付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll tell the staff about the planned switch. Have you arranged contact with the telephone interpreter?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 予約は取っています。友人の電話でつなぐ予定でしたが、友人が帰ると電話もなくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 接続端末も友人が持ち帰る問題を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have a booking. We planned to connect using my friend's phone, but when my friend leaves, the phone will go too.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain the problem that your friend will take the connection device away too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご本人の端末で接続できるか、先に確認しておくとよさそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: It would be a good idea to check beforehand whether you can connect on your own device.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私の端末でつなぎ直します。診察が始まる前に、待合で相手へ短く連絡してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分の端末で事前接続する場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll reconnect using mine. May I briefly contact the interpreter in the waiting area before the consultation begins?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about a place to connect in advance using your own device. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 周囲に配慮して、通話の場所は受付でご相談ください。診察室への接続は担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please ask reception where you can make the call, taking those around you into account. We'll check with the staff about connecting in the consulting room.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人が帰る直前ではなく、今のうちに接続を試しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 退席前に接続確認をする予定を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. I'll test the connection now rather than waiting until just before my friend leaves.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you plan to check the connection before your friend leaves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 通訳者が替わる時は、診察の説明も一度区切ってもらえるよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll ask that the medical explanation pause at a suitable point when the interpreters change.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 助かります。どこまで説明を受けたか私もメモして、新しい通訳者に同じ所からつないでもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 説明の区切りを記録して通訳を引き継ぐと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: That helps. I'll note how far the explanation has reached so the new interpreter can pick up from the same point.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you'll note where the explanation pauses and hand over to the new interpreter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 予定を担当へ申し送りします。では、通話場所を受付でお尋ねください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-YOKKAICHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll pass the plan on to the staff. Please ask reception about a place for the call. Take care.
